prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering the onboarding flow (moving sign-in after adoption selection) was helpful (+5.5%), though the +10.0% prediction was over-optimistic.
Updating intro copy (desktop spawning instructions) showed no clear effect (-0.6%), and the +12.0% prediction was far too high.
Adding progress indicators and tip carousels to the waiting screen showed no clear effect, despite leaning positive (+4.0%, p=0.051).
Layout tweaks (centered mascot intro) provided no benefit (+0.1%) and triggered guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions across all rounds were consistently too high compared to measured results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, layout: +0.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: -0.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +4.0% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +5.5% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Narrative Carousel Redesign: Redesigns the initial story screen into a interactive swipe carousel illustrating how desktop pets live on top of work windows. (why: The choose_path step has a high mean duration of 514s, indicating initial hesitation and unclear value proposition.)
1: [home, wait_info] Estimated Arrival Time Countdown on Waiting Screen: Displays an explicit live time estimate and progress indicator while pet asset generation completes. (why: The waiting step has a high mean time of 2336s, causing user drop-off due to uncertain waiting periods.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Clear Account Recovery Warning on Sign-In Screen: Adds explicit helper text warning users to sign in with their existing account to prevent pet resets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or being reset after signing in with a secondary account.)
3: [finish, hint] Desktop Overlay Controls Quick Hint on Home Intro: Shows a dedicated hint banner explaining how to interact with, hide, or right-click the pet on desktop. (why: 3 support tickets noted confusion over how to control or hide the desktop companion post-onboarding.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Background Notification Prompt: Enables a system desktop notification toggle so users are alerted as soon as waiting asset generation finishes. (why: Waiting step mean time (2336s) shows users leave the app running in background and forget to finish onboarding.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Split Layout Path Option Chooser: Switches the path selection screen to a split comparison layout highlighting standard vs custom options side by side. (why: Users take a median of 8s and mean of 514s on path selection; a clear split layout speeds up decision making.)

scores.note: Choose_path layout/visual redesigns had minimal past lift (+0.1%) and require high build cost.
Wait_info changes previously yielded +4.0% lift, directly addressing long wait duration.
Strong support mail evidence (8 tickets); config/copy change is cheap to test.
Modest support evidence; copy and hint tweaks historically yielded negligible or negative lift.
Targets severe 2336s wait step duration by re-engaging users who leave app in background.
Layout adjustments on choose_path previously produced only +0.1% relative gain.
